data.name: Manabies
data.detailed_description:
Become a Guardian and set out to protect the world of the Manabies.

Explore mysterious floating islands, uncover ancient secrets, rescue magical creatures, and build your own flying home base. Discover rare Manabu seeds, raise your Manabies, strengthen your team, and face dangerous Wonderlings in action-packed arena battles.

At the heart of every adventure lies a unique battle system where visual mathematics becomes part of the gameplay. Mathematical operations unlock attacks, abilities, puzzles, and progression, turning every mission into an engaging challenge that grows alongside the player.

Manabies combines exploration, creature collection, base building, and real-time combat with an adaptive learning system that keeps every player challenged at the right level.

Explore a Living World

Travel between beautiful floating islands filled with hidden paths, resources, characters, and adventures. Complete missions, uncover new locations, and push back the mysterious Wonderlings threatening the skies.

Collect and Raise Magical Creatures

Find rare Manabu seeds throughout the world and watch them grow into adorable Manabies. Build your collection, care for your companions, and expand the team that travels with you on every adventure.

Build Your Flying Home

Upgrade your flying Guardian base into a home for your growing family of Manabies. Unlock new facilities, improve your equipment, and prepare for increasingly challenging expeditions.

Battle with Mathematics

Every encounter is driven by visual mathematical operations. Solve challenges to unleash abilities, overcome obstacles, and defeat enemies. As the adventure becomes more exciting, players naturally solve hundreds of mathematical challenges while focusing on the gameplay itself.

Grows with Every Player

Adaptive difficulty continuously adjusts the experience to match each player’s current understanding. The game covers key elementary mathematics concepts including number sense, arrays, multiplication, fractions, area models, and more.

Proven in Real Classrooms

Manabies is already being used by schools in multiple countries. During early classroom testing, 41% of students voluntarily continued playing at home after first trying the game at school, solving more than 700 math challenges per week on average.

Features

  • Explore a world of magical floating islands.

  • Fight fast-paced arena battles against the Wonderlings.

  • Discover, raise, and evolve adorable Manabies.

  • Build and upgrade your own flying Guardian base.

  • Unlock new missions, islands, and adventures.

  • Battle using a unique mathematics-powered combat system.

  • Adaptive difficulty that grows with each player.

  • Covers essential elementary math concepts through gameplay.

  • No advertisements.

  • Optional Premium subscription with additional content.

Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Windows 7
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 / AMD FX-6300 or equivalent
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 Ti / AMD Radeon R7 360 / Intel UHD 630; OpenGL 3.3 support
  • Storage: 160 MB available space
